inputs.original_text: Her 2026 State of the State agenda would make gunmakers share responsibility for preventing weapons sold in New York from being easily converted into illegal machine guns. That matters: communities should not be left to absorb the harm when an industry could take foreseeable risks seriously. The proposal also includes criminal penalties, but the account doesn’t say who would face them—a detail that will matter for whether accountability reaches the industry or falls elsewhere.
inputs.modified_text: This is a meaningful shift toward making gunmakers share responsibility for preventing weapons sold in New York from being easily converted into illegal machine guns, rather than leaving communities to bear the consequences of foreseeable risks. But criminal penalties are only accountable if they reach the industry and decision-makers—not if they become another tool that disproportionately punishes vulnerable people. The proposal doesn’t say who would face those penalties, and that ambiguity matters.
